# Aesthetic Launch

> Aesthetic Launch helps aesthetic practices add name-brand lasers and energy-based devices on flexible terms, with delivery, installation, staff training and service support.

## Primary audience

- New aesthetic practices adding their first device
- Established practices expanding their treatment menu
- Multi-location practices expanding their device fleet
- Shared treatment spaces serving independent providers

## Treatment technologies

- Skin tightening
- Pigmentation treatment
- Skin rejuvenation
- Laser hair reduction
- Skin resurfacing
- Vascular lesion treatment

## Device brands

- Sciton
- Lumenis
- Solta
- Cutera

## Additional services

- Purchasing idle devices from owners
- Subleasing idle devices from owners

## Contact

Use the inquiry form on the website to request availability, pricing and delivery timing.
